name: Stage 44:1: Jogersö. Oxelösund to Ryssbergen
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 44:1, Jogersö. Oxelösund to Ryssbergen.
utilities: Official area: Nyköpings kommun, Oxelösunds kommun.

Jogersö Eco Camp/start area is the strongest start-service node with paid camping, toilets, showers, drinking water/service-house context, seasonal kiosk/small grocery, restaurant/lunch nearby, parking, and beach facilities.

Stjärnholm provides mid-route parking, bus access, and lodging/meal context; verify current Stiftsgården opening and meal arrangements before relying on it because food is more booked-guest/event oriented than guaranteed drop-in trail service. Older hiker reports also flag weak marking/heavy loose gravel around Stjärnholm/riding-path sections, so keep an offline map handy.

Ryssbergen is the endpoint facility cluster with shelter, tap/drinking-water point, nearby toilet, parking, viewpoint, and Ärilä bus access. The small Skillerhultsvägen parking is the main connection back to stage 44.

Public transport is useful but not door-to-door: Jogersövägen is the likely start bus approach, Stjärnholm/Stjärnholmsbadet are mid-route bailouts, Ärila serves the Ryssbergen side, and Nyköping C/Nyköping busstation are the broader rail/bus anchors.

Tempo Oxelösund Sundstigen is the closest proper start-side grocery to the trail corridor. ICA Kvantum Oxelösund and Nyköping/Gumsbacken services are useful town-service options but may be around the 2 km/off-route threshold depending on the selected route.
waterSources: Jogersö Eco Camp/start services and Stjärnholm can be refill/service options when open, but they are not wilderness water sources.

Kvarndammen/St Bene is a strong shelter/rest point, but no reliable official water was confirmed there. A 2018 hiker report found water at the dam dry, and a municipal near-nature source mentions a small spring near Kvarndammen that is not listed as a Sörmlandsleden stage water point; treat this whole area as carry-water territory.
The official spring before Ryssbergen at 58.735100, 16.968467 is the main natural water source. Filter/boil/treat unless current signage confirms potable water.
The Ryssbergen tap/drinking-water point beside the shelter is the best listed endpoint refill, but verify seasonality/function in the field.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden distance is 16.5 km after the July 2025 Jogersöbron-Femöre update; Naturkartan/older official-GPX geometry is about 15.8 km, OSM relation 9628430 measures about 16.1-16.2 km despite a stale 15 km tag, and AllTrails shows about 14.6-14.8 km. Use 16.5 km as the catalog distance and the OSM relation as the best current drawn line until a refreshed official GPX is available.

The route starts at Jogersö/Oxelösund, passes urban-edge paths and small roads, Stjärnholm/Stjärnholmsviken, Kvarndammen/St Bene, forest/ancient-remains areas, Bränn-Ekeby/Källbo, golf-course edges near Ärila/Nyköpings golf, Ryssbergen, and connects to stage 44 near Skillerhultsvägen.

Stage 44:1 is a branch/access route, not the stage-44 mainline. To continue toward Lindbacke, switch to stage 44 at the Ryssbergen/Skillerhultsvägen connection. Route-builder snapping should use the Stage 44 connection near OSM node 3074881314 at 58.734840,16.955879, not Lindbacke.

Official July 2025 update added/new-routed the Jogersöbron-Femöre part and opened a new Femöre shelter on 2025-07-09. The current drawing uses OSM relation 9628430, version 14 from 2025-12-25, because it postdates the reroute. The Arknat Hide&Seek shelter belongs clearly to the Femöre loop/extension context; do not stitch the full Femöre loop or shelter into the classic Jogersö-Ryssbergen line until official stage geometry confirms the exact extension.
Official 2026-04-20 comment reports forestry/thinning just south of Björshultsvägen, north of Stjärnholm; markings were improved, but the area may remain messy for a while.

Official stage page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 verification pass, aside from the 2026-04-20 forestry/thinning comment. Older hiker reports describe wet/muddy going around the Jogersö-Stjärnholm and post-Stjärnholm wetland/boardwalk sections, slippery descents after rain, poor marking around a riding/gravel section near Stjärnholm, high grass, and a confusing golf-course edge. Treat these as seasonal/condition-dependent but plausible.

A hiker report flagged awkward wayfinding around the Ärila/Nyköping golf-course edge, with high grass and a moment of uncertainty near tee/fairway context. Watch markers and local golf-course signs carefully.
Svanviken/Kilaån bridge warning near the Ryssbergen/Svanviken/Kastalen/Lindbacke area can affect nearby loops and continuations; use alternatives via Kastalen/Skillerhultsvägen where relevant.

Ryssbergen reserve rules found in the visitor source: dogs leashed on exercise/riding trails and riding forbidden on prepared exercise tracks. No blanket Ryssbergen tent/fire ban was verified, so apply allemansrätten, local signs, and current fire bans.
Svanviken-Lindbacke reserve rules are stricter for side trips/continuations: no tenting/caravans, no fires, dogs leashed, and do not disturb birdlife.

Femöre/Jogersö local rules matter near the start/extension: dogs may need to be leashed in bathing/exercise/recreation areas, disposable grills are not allowed at Jogersö Eco Camp, and overnight tenting is not allowed in Femöre reserve except where explicitly permitted.

facilities.name: Jogersö / stage 44:1 start
facilities.description: Official branch start at Jogersö/Oxelösund, close to parking, beach, camping, toilets, and food/service options.

facilities.name: Jogersö start parking
facilities.description: Parking near the official stage start and beach/camping area. Follow local signs and seasonal restrictions.

facilities.name: Jogersö Eco Camp
facilities.description: Paid organized camping with tent/camper/cabin options, service-house utilities, showers, toilets, drinking-water/service context, seasonal kiosk/shop, laundry booking, Wi-Fi hotspot, and nearby restaurant. Dogs must be leashed and disposable grills are not allowed in the camping area.

facilities.name: Jogersö tent area grills
facilities.description: Paid campsite tent-area context with outdoor grills/seating near the new service house. Use only as a campsite/customer facility and follow campsite rules.

facilities.name: Jogersö beach public toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet near Jogersö havsbad/start area; verify seasonal access.

facilities.name: Paus / Restaurang Jogersö
facilities.description: Restaurant/lunch option near Jogersö. Opening hours vary seasonally.

facilities.name: Jogersö local dog/fire rules
facilities.description: Local/campsite rules can require dogs on leash in recreation/bathing areas and forbid disposable grills in the camping area. Use established grills only where allowed.

facilities.name: Jogersövägen bus approach
facilities.description: Likely start-side bus approach toward Oxelösund/Nyköping, but not at the trailhead; expect an approach walk and verify current timetable.

facilities.name: Sundstigen bus / Tempo context
facilities.description: Bus approach north of Jogersö with nearby Tempo service context around Oxelösund. Useful for start logistics, not directly on the trailhead.

facilities.name: Tempo Oxelösund Sundstigen
facilities.description: Small grocery/service option north of the Jogersö start area. Off the immediate trailhead; opening hours vary.

facilities.name: ICA Kvantum Oxelösund
facilities.description: Officially named town resupply option in Oxelösund, around the 2 km/off-route threshold from parts of the start-side corridor. Verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Femöre extension / Hide&Seek caveat
facilities.description: New 2025 Femöre shelter/loop context is well documented, but it sits outside the classic Jogersö-Ryssbergen line. Add it only as a selected Femöre extension/loop option, not automatically to 44:1.

facilities.name: Stjärnholmsbadet bus stop
facilities.description: Mid-route bus/access option east of Stjärnholm. Verify line and timetable before planning around it.

facilities.name: Stjärnholm bus stop
facilities.description: Useful mid-route bailout/access stop by Stjärnholm. Opposite-side stop is mapped nearby; verify current Sörmlandstrafiken timetable.

facilities.name: Stjärnholm parking
facilities.description: Parking/access near Stjärnholm. Coordinate is from map triangulation; follow local signs.

facilities.name: Stiftsgården Stjärnholm
facilities.description: Lodging/restaurant/meal-package context near the route. Treat meals as booked/event/guest dependent rather than guaranteed drop-in hiker service.

facilities.name: Björshultsvägen forestry warning
facilities.description: Official 2026-04-20 comment reports forestry/thinning south of Björshultsvägen, north of Stjärnholm; markings were improved but terrain may remain messy.

facilities.name: Stjärnholm wet/boardwalk and marking warning
facilities.description: Older hiker reports describe wet grass, mud, slippery descents, boardwalk/wetland context after rain, and a poorly marked riding/gravel section that caused a wrong turn. Conditions vary; waterproof footwear and offline map help.

facilities.name: Kvarndammen / St Bene shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after roughly 9 km, also mapped by shelter sources; OSM notes wooden-floor/fireplace context. Shared, first-come; no reliable official water point confirmed here.

facilities.name: Kvarndammen shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill context at the shelter. Fire bans override and Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee firewood.

facilities.name: Kvarndammen unverified spring context
facilities.description: A municipal near-nature source mentions a small spring used by hikers near Kvarndammen, but it is not an official Sörmlandsleden water point; a 2018 hiker report found water at the dam dry. Treat as unverified and carry water.

facilities.name: Palmtorp bus bailout
facilities.description: Possible bus/access option east of Kvarndammen/motorway area. Verify current service.

facilities.name: Källbo forest-road tent spot
facilities.description: Approximate official suitable tenting area: a small turning area by a forest road near Källbo, east of Bränn-Ekeby. Exact coordinate is low confidence and this is not a formal campsite; keep it low-impact.

facilities.name: Bränn-Ekeby bus access
facilities.description: Possible access/bailout near the Källbo tent area; verify timetable and walking route.

facilities.name: Ärila/Nyköping golf-course edge
facilities.description: Route passes near/along golf-course context. A hiker report describes high grass and confusing wayfinding near tee/fairway context; pay attention to markings, players, and local signs.

facilities.name: Nyköpings Golfklubb services
facilities.description: Nearby golf-club restaurant/service context; hours are seasonal and it is not a guaranteed trail service.

facilities.name: Ärila bus access
facilities.description: Bus access near the later Ryssbergen side; Naturkartan describes Ärila as a reserve access stop about 1.5 km away. Verify timetable.

facilities.name: Svanviken bird ramp/platform spur
facilities.description: Marked spur about 300-350 m before Ryssbergen to an accessible boardwalk/platform with nearby accessible dry toilet/parking context. Side-area facility; check bridge warnings and reserve rules.

facilities.name: Svanviken side-area rules
facilities.description: For the Svanviken side area: no tenting/caravans, no fires, dogs leashed, and do not disturb birdlife. Kilaån bridge is currently flagged unsafe/closed; Naturkartan recommends alternatives via Kastalen/Skillerhultsvägen.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen cold spring
facilities.description: Official cold spring beside the trail before Ryssbergen. Natural source; filter/boil/treat unless current signage confirms potable water.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/end facility cluster for 44:1, with nearby tap and fireplace/grill context. Shared, first-come.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen tap / drinking water
facilities.description: Mapped tap/drinking-water point beside the Ryssbergen shelter. Verify on site.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen shelter fireplace context
facilities.description: Shelter/fireplace context reported by shelter sources and general Sörmlandsleden shelter guidance. Use only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen / Ryssbergsbacken toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet near the Ryssbergen recreation area, slightly off the shelter/tap cluster. Verify seasonal opening/access.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen recreation parking
facilities.description: Parking by the Ryssbergen recreation/ski-slope side near the toilet. Follow local signs.

facilities.name: Ryssbergsbacken viewpoint
facilities.description: Officially recommended short detour to the ski-slope/viewpoint area for views over Nyköping and Kiladalen.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen reserve rules
facilities.description: Dogs must be leashed on exercise and riding trails; riding is forbidden on prepared exercise tracks. Check local signs for any additional rules.

facilities.name: Skillerhultsvägen / stage 44 connection
facilities.description: Connection point where branch 44:1 meets the stage-44 main route about 600 m west of Ryssbergen. Snap route-builder joins near OSM node 3074881314 at 58.734840,16.955879. Small parking nearby.

facilities.name: Skillerhultsvägen small parking
facilities.description: Small parking/access by the branch connection to stage 44. Capacity likely limited; do not block the road.

facilities.name: Nyköping busstation access
facilities.description: Broader bus hub for the Nyköping/Ryssbergen side, more than 2 km from parts of the branch. Useful for planning but not a trailhead.

facilities.name: Nyköping C rail access
facilities.description: Nearest practical rail hub for the Ryssbergen/Lindbacke side, but more than 2 km off the branch and should be treated as access context.
